unit.title: Measures
unit.blurb: Measuring length in centimetres and metres, mass in grams and kilograms, capacity in millilitres and litres, and reading scales.
unit.subject: maths

O1.t: Measure and compare lengths in centimetres and metres.

O2.t: Choose units for mass and capacity and read simple scales.

p: Short things are measured in **centimetres** (cm): a pencil is about 15 cm. Long things are measured in **metres** (m): a bus is about 12 m. 1 m = 100 cm.
Line one end up with **0**. Read the number at the other end.

p: Light things are measured in **grams** (g). Heavier things are measured in **kilograms** (kg). 1 kg = 1000 g.
Small amounts of liquid are measured in **millilitres** (ml). Large amounts are measured in **litres** (l). 1 l = 1000 ml.
